Gus sits directly after Cara, and Finn sits exactly two slots from Gus. The only placement that also keeps Cara and Finn three or more slots apart puts Finn three slots after Cara.

Ann, Hana, and Ivo all come before Cara, so Cara starts at slot 4 or later. Elif comes at least three after Cara and sits exactly two from Dev. Those conditions leave one lineup: Cara in 5, Gus in 6, Finn in 8, Dev in 7, Elif in 9. Ann–Ivo (exactly one between), Ann before Hana, and Ann–Ben (three or more apart) then fill slots 1–4 as Ann, Hana, Ivo, Ben.
